checks.behavior: Each legacy number, tab, and control (behavior contract section 2) maps to a new total or column, or to its reason in section 5.
The new page has the totals strip with six totals, then the schools table, and no tab, no range control, no Export, no Refresh, no AI insights.
The page has no System Dashboard Description text.
Schools, students, teachers, active students this week, articles opened this week, and seats used of seats equal Q-A. The note for students without a school shows only when Q-C is more than 0.
Each school row (students, active students and percent, articles opened, seats or No license, last activity day in Bangkok, status) equals Q-B.
Each school with students and no activity event in the last 7 Bangkok days shows Quiet (a mark and the word) and sits in the first rows.
A school without students shows No students and not Quiet.
A tap on the row of PARITY_SCHOOL_ID opens /admin/dashboard?school=<id> and the URL keeps school=<id>.
The admin dashboard shows the school selector set to that school, and its student total equals the students of that row in Q-B.
The school ADMIN gets no dashboard. The proxy sends the user to the unauthorized page in the new build, as legacy refuses access.
